```{r setup, message=FALSE}
library(arrow)
library(conflicted)

library(forcats)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggtext)
library(gt)
library(lubridate)
library(purrr)
library(scales)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)

conflict_prefer_all("dplyr", quiet = TRUE)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

# Add a nice ordinal to a date (e.g. Feb 23rd, 2026)
format_date_ordinal <- function(d) {
  day <- as.integer(format(d, "%d"))
  suffix <- if (day %in% c(11, 12, 13)) {
    "th"
  } else {
    switch(as.character(day %% 10), "1" = "st", "2" = "nd", "3" = "rd", "th")
  }
  paste0(format(d, "%b. "), day, suffix, format(d, ", %Y"))
}
```

```{r load_data}
DATA_DIR <- "data/output"
DATA_DATE <- as.Date("2026-02-26")

# Load each parquet file in data/output/, stripping the date prefix to
# create the dataframe name (e.g. 2026_02_18_payer_files_feb.parquet
# becomes payer_files_feb).
payer_files <- list.files(
  DATA_DIR,
  pattern = paste0("^", gsub("-", "_", DATA_DATE), ".*\\.parquet$"),
  full.names = TRUE
)
for (path in payer_files) {
  name <- sub(
    "^\\d{4}_\\d{2}_\\d{2}_",
    "",
    tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(path))
  )
  assign(
    name,
    read_parquet(path) |>
      # Convert payer_id to char and grab the first number as a version. Most
      # have a mix of semver and string versions (e.g. 1.0.0, v1, 1.0), so this
      # correctly grabs just the "1" for version
      mutate(across(any_of("payer_id"), \(x) as.character(x))) |>
      mutate(across(
        any_of("version"),
        \(x) str_extract(version, "\\d+"),
        .names = "{.col}_parsed"
      ))
  )
}

# Build a payer name lookup table w/ covered lives. Add a boolean of top 50
# payers for use between plots
payer_names <- payer_files_dec |>
  distinct(payer_id, payer_name) |>
  group_by(payer_id) |>
  slice_head(n = 1) |>
  ungroup() |>
  left_join(payer_lives, by = c("payer_id" = "tq_payer_payer_id")) |>
  select(payer_id, payer_name, payer_lives = lives) |>
  mutate(
    payer_name = str_replace_all(payer_name, "Blue Cross Blue Shield", "BCBS"),
    payer_name = replace_values(
      payer_name,
      "BCBS of Pennsylvania (Capital Blue Cross)" ~
        "BCBS of Pennsylvania (CBC)",
      "Healthcare Management Administrators (HMA)" ~ "HMA",
      "Ventura County Health Care Plan (VCHCP)" ~ "VCHCP",
      "Innovation Health Insurance Company" ~ "Innovation"
    )
  )

top_n_payer_ids <- payer_names |>
  slice_max(payer_lives, n = 50) |>
  pull(payer_id)

# Grab the unique network names + count per data source/file
network_names_per_file_feb <- payer_files_feb |>
  select(payer_id, data_source_name) |>
  left_join(network_names_feb, by = c("payer_id", "data_source_name")) |>
  group_by(payer_id, data_source_name) |>
  summarize(
    nn_unique_names_lst_feb = list(unique(str_trim(flatten_chr(
      network_names
    )))),
    nn_unique_names_cnt_feb = map_int(nn_unique_names_lst_feb, \(x) length(x))
  )

# Grab the most common network name by payer + count of that name across all
# files from that payer
network_names_ranked_per_payer_feb <- network_names_per_file_feb |>
  unnest(cols = nn_unique_names_lst_feb) |>
  ungroup() |>
  count(payer_id, nn_unique_names_lst_feb) |>
  arrange(payer_id, desc(n)) |>
  filter(row_number() <= 1, .by = payer_id) |>
  select(
    payer_id,
    nn_most_common_name_feb = nn_unique_names_lst_feb,
    nn_most_common_name_feb_file_count = n
  )

# Join various payer datasets to make our main working table. One row per payer.
# First we grab the count of data source names for each month, plus the count
# of different TiC schema versions
payer_df <- payer_files_dec |>
  distinct(payer_id, data_source_name, version_parsed) |>
  summarize(
    n_dsn_dec = n(),
    n_dsn_v1_dec = sum(version_parsed == 1),
    n_dsn_v2_dec = sum(version_parsed == 2),
    .by = "payer_id"
  ) |>
  left_join(
    payer_files_feb |>
      distinct(payer_id, data_source_name, version_parsed) |>
      summarize(
        n_dsn_feb = n(),
        n_dsn_v1_feb = sum(version_parsed == 1),
        n_dsn_v2_feb = sum(version_parsed == 2),
        .by = "payer_id"
      ),
    by = "payer_id"
  ) |>
  # Attach expected number of INR files for each month, where "expected" means
  # files that will eventually be ingested / processed. We assume this number
  # doesn't change within a given month (i.e. once files are posted for Feb,
  # the payer won't come back and post more files)
  left_join(
    parsing_status_dec |>
      filter(
        !is_skipped,
        !is_broken,
        !has_error,
        schema == "in-network-rates"
      ) |>
      summarize(num_files_expected_dec = n(), .by = "payer_id"),
    by = "payer_id"
  ) |>
  left_join(
    parsing_status_feb |>
      filter(
        !is_skipped,
        !is_broken,
        !has_error,
        schema == "in-network-rates"
      ) |>
      summarize(num_files_expected_feb = n(), .by = "payer_id"),
    by = "payer_id"
  ) |>
  # Attach metadata (size, num external reference files) for parsed files.
  # Here we only take data for files successfully ingested (no size, ref data
  # exists for parsing or errored files)
  left_join(
    parsing_status_dec |>
      filter(state == "succeed", schema == "in-network-rates") |>
      group_by(payer_id) |>
      summarize(
        num_files_parsed_dec = n(),
        tot_file_bytes_dec = sum(raw_file_size_bytes, na.rm = TRUE),
        avg_file_bytes_dec = mean(raw_file_size_bytes, na.rm = TRUE)
      ),
    by = "payer_id"
  ) |>
  left_join(
    parsing_status_feb |>
      filter(state == "succeed", schema == "in-network-rates") |>
      group_by(payer_id) |>
      summarize(
        num_files_parsed_feb = n(),
        tot_file_bytes_feb = sum(raw_file_size_bytes, na.rm = TRUE),
        avg_file_bytes_feb = mean(raw_file_size_bytes, na.rm = TRUE)
      ),
    by = "payer_id"
  ) |>
  # Diff expected vs parsed files, and convert raw byte values to nice strings
  mutate(
    diff_expected_files = num_files_expected_feb - num_files_expected_dec,
    diff_parsed_files = num_files_parsed_feb - num_files_parsed_dec,
    diff_bytes = tot_file_bytes_feb - tot_file_bytes_dec,
    diff_avg_bytes = avg_file_bytes_feb - avg_file_bytes_dec,
    across(
      contains("bytes"),
      \(x) {
        case_when(
        abs(x) >= 1099511627776 ~ paste(round(x / 1099511627776.0, 1), "TB"),
        abs(x) >= 1073741824 ~ paste(round(x / 1073741824.0, 1), "GB"),
        abs(x) >= 1048576 ~ paste(round(x / 1048576.0, 1), "MB"),
        abs(x) >= 1024 ~ paste(round(x / 1024.0, 1), "KB")
      )
      },
      .names = "{.col}_parsed"
    )
  ) |>
  left_join(payer_names, by = "payer_id") |>
  relocate(payer_id, payer_name, payer_lives) |>
  # Attach network_name stats per payer, aggregating from the per payer + data
  # source name level dataframe
  left_join(
    network_names_per_file_feb |>
      group_by(payer_id) |>
      summarize(
        nn_pct_of_posted = mean(
          nn_unique_names_cnt_feb > 0,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),
        nn_unique_names_lst_feb = list(unique(flatten_chr(
          nn_unique_names_lst_feb
        ))),
        nn_avg_unique_names_per_file = mean(
          nn_unique_names_cnt_feb[nn_unique_names_cnt_feb != 0],
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),
        nn_avg_unique_names_per_file = case_when(
          is.nan(nn_avg_unique_names_per_file) ~ NA,
          .default = nn_avg_unique_names_per_file
        ),
        nn_unique_names_cnt_feb = map_int(nn_unique_names_lst_feb, length)
      ),
    by = "payer_id"
  ) |>
  left_join(
    network_names_ranked_per_payer_feb,
    by = "payer_id"
  ) |>
  # Attach provider_group mode stats (i.e. inline, external, internal provider
  # groups). External vs internal provider group (PG) references aren't
  # differentiated in the INR schema itself. Instead, we get the number of
  # external PGs by seeing if a given data source name had a "location file"
  # associated with it when parsing
  left_join(
    provider_mode_dec |>
      left_join(
        parsing_status_dec |>
          filter(state == "succeed", schema == "in-network-rates") |>
          select(payer_id, data_source_name, parsed_location_files),
        by = c("payer_id", "data_source_name")
      ) |>
      mutate(
        provider_mode = case_when(
          parsed_location_files > 0 ~ "external",
          provider_mode == "reference" ~ "internal",
          .default = provider_mode
        )
      ) |>
      # Drop payers with multiple ref types per file (there are only a few)
      arrange(desc(provider_mode)) |>
      distinct(payer_id, data_source_name, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
      group_by(payer_id) |>
      summarize(
        num_dsn_pg_inline_dec = sum(provider_mode == "inline"),
        num_dsn_pg_ref_ext_dec = sum(provider_mode == "external"),
        num_dsn_pg_ref_int_dec = sum(provider_mode == "internal")
      ),
    by = "payer_id"
  ) |>
  left_join(
    provider_mode_feb |>
      left_join(
        parsing_status_feb |>
          filter(state == "succeed", schema == "in-network-rates") |>
          select(payer_id, data_source_name, parsed_location_files),
        by = c("payer_id", "data_source_name")
      ) |>
      mutate(
        provider_mode = case_when(
          parsed_location_files > 0 ~ "external",
          provider_mode == "reference" ~ "internal",
          .default = provider_mode
        )
      ) |>
      arrange(desc(provider_mode)) |>
      distinct(payer_id, data_source_name, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
      group_by(payer_id) |>
      summarize(
        num_dsn_pg_inline_feb = sum(provider_mode == "inline"),
        num_dsn_pg_ref_ext_feb = sum(provider_mode == "external"),
        num_dsn_pg_ref_int_feb = sum(provider_mode == "internal")
      ),
    by = "payer_id"
  ) |>
  relocate(starts_with("num_dsn_pg"), .after = everything()) |>
  relocate(starts_with("num_files"), .after = n_dsn_v2_feb) |>
  relocate(starts_with("tot_file"), .after = num_files_parsed_feb) |>
  relocate(starts_with("diff"), .after = avg_file_bytes_feb_parsed)
```

# Version plots

---

```{r plt_version_adoption_overall}
#| column: page
#| out-width: 100%
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 6.5

version_adoption_df <- payer_df |>
  mutate(
    n_dsn_v1_dec = replace_values(n_dsn_v1_dec, NA ~ n_dsn_dec),
    n_dsn_v2_dec = replace_values(n_dsn_v2_dec, NA ~ 0)
  ) |>
  summarize(
    v1_dec = sum(n_dsn_v1_dec > 0 & n_dsn_v2_dec == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    v2_dec = sum(n_dsn_v2_dec > 0 & n_dsn_v1_dec == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    v1_v2_dec = sum(n_dsn_v1_dec != 0 & n_dsn_v2_dec != 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    v1_feb = sum(n_dsn_v1_feb > 0 & n_dsn_v2_feb == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    v2_feb = sum(n_dsn_v2_feb > 0 & n_dsn_v1_feb == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    v1_v2_feb = sum(n_dsn_v1_feb != 0 & n_dsn_v2_feb != 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    vmissing_dec = n() - v1_dec - v2_dec - v1_v2_dec,
    vmissing_feb = n() - v1_feb - v2_feb - v1_v2_feb,
    across(starts_with("v"), \(x) x / n(), .names = "pct_{.col}")
  ) |>
  rename_with(\(x) paste0("cnt_", x), starts_with("v")) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = c("stat", "version", "month"),
    names_pattern = "(pct|cnt)_(v.*)_(dec|feb)",
    values_to = "value"
  ) |>
  filter_out(version == "vmissing" & month == "dec") |>
  mutate(
    version = recode_values(
      version,
      "v1" ~ "All V1<br>files",
      "v1_v2" ~ "Mixed<br>(V1 & V2)",
      "v2" ~ "All V2<br>files",
      "vmissing" ~ "Missing all<br>Feb. files"
    ),
    month = recode_values(
      month,
      "dec" ~ "December 2025",
      "feb" ~ "February 2026"
    )
  ) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = "stat", values_from = "value") |>
  mutate(
    version = factor(
      version,
      levels = c(
        "All V1<br>files",
        "Mixed<br>(V1 & V2)",
        "All V2<br>files",
        "Missing all<br>Feb. files"
      )
    ),
    label = paste0(
      cnt,
      "<br>",
      "<span style='font-size:12px;color:grey30'>(",
      label_percent()(pct),
      ")</span>"
    )
  )

ggplot(version_adoption_df) +
  geom_col(
    aes(y = cnt, x = version, fill = version)
  ) +
  geom_richtext(
    aes(y = cnt, x = version, label = label),
    nudge_y = 10,
    size = 4.5,
    label.colour = "transparent",
    fill = "transparent",
    lineheight = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_comma()) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "All V1<br>files" = "#fc8d62",
      "Mixed<br>(V1 & V2)" = "#8da0cb",
      "All V2<br>files" = "#66c2a5",
      "Missing all<br>Feb. files" = "grey80"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste0(
      "Overall TiC 2.0 schema adoption as of ",
      format_date_ordinal(DATA_DATE)
    ),
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Of ",
      version_adoption_df |>
        filter(
          month == "February 2026",
          version != "Missing all<br>Feb. files"
        ) |>
        summarize(n = sum(cnt)) |>
        pull(n),
      " payers with Feb. files, just ",
      version_adoption_df |>
        filter(
          month == "February 2026",
          version == "All V2<br>files"
        ) |>
        summarize(n = sum(cnt)) |>
        pull(n),
      " have fully adopted the ",
      "TiC 2.0 schema"
    ),
    caption = paste0(
      "Data from Turquoise Health payer database of in-network rate files. ",
      "Version is self-reported by payers and may not actually reflect ",
      "file changes"
    ),
    x = "",
    y = "Count of payers"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(vars(month), strip.position = "bottom", scales = "free_x") +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_markdown(
      size = 20,
      face = "bold",
      margin = margin(b = 8, l = -26)
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_markdown(
      size = 15,
      margin = margin(b = 12, l = -26),
      lineheight = 1.1
    ),
    plot.caption = element_text(
      size = 9,
      lineheight = 1.1,
      margin = margin(t = 12)
    ),
    axis.title.x = element_markdown(
      margin = margin(t = 10),
      size = 16,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.title.y = element_text(
      margin = margin(r = 10),
      size = 16,
      lineheight = 1.1,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.text.x.bottom = element_markdown(
      size = 12,
      margin = margin(t = -8),
      lineheight = 1.3
    ),
    axis.text.y.left = element_markdown(
      size = 12,
      lineheight = 1.3
    ),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(1, "cm"),
    strip.placement = "outside",
    strip.text.x.bottom = element_markdown(
      size = 16,
      face = "bold",
      margin = margin(t = 10)
    )
  )
```

```{r plt_version_adoption_by_payer}
#| column: page
#| out-width: 100%
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 9

payer_df |>
  filter(payer_id %in% top_n_payer_ids) |>
  mutate(
    n_dsn_feb = pmin(replace_values(n_dsn_feb, NA ~ 0), num_files_expected_feb),
    n_dsn_v1_feb = replace_values(n_dsn_v1_feb, NA ~ n_dsn_feb),
    n_dsn_v2_feb = replace_values(n_dsn_v2_feb, NA ~ 0),
    num_files_expected_feb = replace_values(
      num_files_expected_feb,
      NA ~ num_files_expected_dec
    ),
    n_dsn_missing_feb = num_files_expected_feb - (n_dsn_v1_feb + n_dsn_v2_feb)
  ) |>
  select(
    payer_id,
    payer_name,
    payer_lives,
    starts_with("n_dsn_v"),
    starts_with("n_dsn_m"),
    starts_with("num_files_exp")
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("n_dsn"),
    names_to = c("version", "month"),
    values_to = "count",
    names_pattern = "n_dsn_(missing|v1|v2)_(dec|feb)"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    payer_name = fct_reorder(payer_name, payer_lives),
    pct = count /
      ifelse(
        month == "dec",
        num_files_expected_dec,
        num_files_expected_feb
      ),
    version = fct_rev(factor(
      recode_values(
        version,
        "v1" ~ "V1",
        "v2" ~ "V2",
        "missing" ~ "Missing or not yet parsed"
      ),
      levels = c("V2", "V1", "Missing or not yet parsed")
    ))
  ) |>
  filter(month != "dec") |>
  mutate(
    v2_pct = pct[version == "V2"],
    v1_pct = pct[version == "V1"],
    .by = "payer_id"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(v2_pct), desc(v1_pct)) |>
  mutate(payer_name = fct_rev(fct_reorder(payer_name, row_number()))) |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_col(
    aes(y = payer_name, x = pct, fill = version),
    width = 0.8
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "V1" = "#fc8d62",
      "V2" = "#66c2a5",
      "Missing or not yet parsed" = "grey80"
    )
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = label_percent(), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(title = "", reverse = TRUE)) +
  labs(
    title = paste0(
      "Payer-level TiC 2.0 schema adoption as of ",
      format_date_ordinal(DATA_DATE)
    ),
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Of the top 50 payers*, most are still transitioning ",
      "or have yet to post all Feb. files"
    ),
    caption = paste0(
      "Data from Turquoise Health payer database of in-network rate files. ",
      "Version is self-reported by payers and may not actually reflect ",
      "file changes<br>",
      "* Top payers are chosen by number of national covered lives, but ",
      "plot order is by percent adoption of V2 schema"
    ),
    y = "",
    x = "Percent of payer files by type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_markdown(
      size = 19,
      face = "bold",
      margin = margin(b = 8, l = -150)
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_markdown(
      size = 15,
      margin = margin(b = 12, l = -150),
      lineheight = 1.1
    ),
    plot.caption = element_markdown(
      size = 9,
      lineheight = 1.1,
      margin = margin(t = 12, b = 4, r = -15)
    ),
    axis.title.x = element_markdown(
      margin = margin(t = 10),
      size = 16,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.title.y = element_text(
      margin = margin(r = 10),
      size = 16,
      lineheight = 1.1,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.text.x.bottom = element_markdown(
      size = 12,
      lineheight = 1.3
    ),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(1, "cm"),
    axis.ticks.x = element_line(color = "grey40"),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.box.margin = margin(b = -6),
    legend.margin = margin(l = -10, r = 8, t = 6, b = 6),
    legend.text = element_text(
      size = 12
    ),
    legend.title = element_text(
      size = 14,
      face = "bold",
      margin = margin(r = 20)
    ),
    legend.background = element_rect(color = "grey20"),
    plot.margin = margin(l = -20, r = 20, t = 6)
  )
```

# Provider group plots

---

```{r plt_pg_overall}
#| column: page
#| out-width: 100%
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 6.5

payer_df |>
  summarize(
    across(
      c("n_dsn_dec", "n_dsn_feb") | starts_with("num_dsn_pg"),
      \(x) sum(x, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("num_dsn_pg"),
    names_to = c("ref_type", "month"),
    names_pattern = "num_dsn_pg_(.*)_(dec|feb)",
    values_to = "count"
  ) |>
  mutate(pct = count / ifelse(month == "dec", n_dsn_dec, n_dsn_feb)) |>
  mutate(
    ref_type = factor(
      paste0(ref_type, "-", month),
      levels = c(
        "inline-dec",
        "ref_ext-dec",
        "ref_int-dec",
        "inline-feb",
        "ref_ext-feb",
        "ref_int-feb"
      )
    ),
    ref_type_fct = fct_relabel(
      ref_type,
      \(x) {
        case_when(
          ref_type == "inline-dec" ~ paste0(
            "**Inline<br>references**<br>",
            "<span style='font-size:13px'>(allowed in 1.0)</span>"
          ),
          ref_type == "ref_ext-dec" ~ paste0(
            "**External<br>references**<br>",
            "<span style='font-size:13px'>(allowed in 1.0)</span>"
          ),
          ref_type == "ref_int-dec" ~ paste0(
            "**Internal<br>references**<br>",
            "<span style='font-size:13px'>(allowed in 1.0)</span>"
          ),
          ref_type == "inline-feb" ~ paste0(
            "**Inline<br>references**<br>",
            "<span style='font-size:13px'>(banned in 1.0)</span>"
          ),
          ref_type == "ref_ext-feb" ~ paste0(
            "**External<br>references**<br>",
            "<span style='font-size:13px'>(banned in 1.0)</span>"
          ),
          ref_type == "ref_int-feb" ~ paste0(
            "**Internal<br>references**<br>",
            "<span style='font-size:13px'>(required in 2.0)</span>"
          )
        )
      }
    ),
    month = recode_values(
      month,
      "dec" ~ "December 2025",
      "feb" ~ "February 2026"
    ),
    label = label_percent()(pct)
  ) |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_col(
    aes(y = pct, x = ref_type_fct, fill = ref_type)
  ) +
  geom_richtext(
    aes(y = pct, x = ref_type_fct, label = label),
    nudge_y = 0.025,
    size = 4.5,
    label.colour = "transparent",
    fill = "transparent",
    lineheight = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_percent()) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "inline-dec" = "#fc8d62",
      "ref_ext-dec" = "#8da0cb",
      "ref_int-dec" = "#66c2a5",
      "inline-feb" = "#fc8d62",
      "ref_ext-feb" = "#8da0cb",
      "ref_int-feb" = "#66c2a5"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste0(
      "Provider reference schema adoption as of ",
      format_date_ordinal(DATA_DATE),
      "*"
    ),
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Most payers were already using the internal ",
      "provider groups required in TiC 2.0"
    ),
    caption = paste0(
      "Data from Turquoise Health payer database of in-network rate files<br>",
      "* Shown as a percentage of *posted* files. Not all files are ",
      "posted / parsed for February. Percentages may change as more ",
      "files are added"
    ),
    x = "",
    y = "Percent of posted payer files by type"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(vars(month), strip.position = "bottom", scales = "free_x") +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_markdown(
      size = 19,
      face = "bold",
      margin = margin(b = 8, l = -30)
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_markdown(
      size = 15,
      margin = margin(b = 12, l = -30),
      lineheight = 1.1
    ),
    plot.caption = element_markdown(
      size = 9,
      lineheight = 1.1,
      margin = margin(t = 12)
    ),
    axis.title.x = element_markdown(
      margin = margin(t = 10),
      size = 16,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.title.y = element_text(
      margin = margin(r = 10),
      size = 16,
      lineheight = 1.1,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.text.x.bottom = element_markdown(
      size = 12,
      margin = margin(t = -8),
      lineheight = 1.1
    ),
    axis.text.y.left = element_markdown(
      size = 12,
      lineheight = 1.3
    ),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(1, "cm"),
    strip.placement = "outside",
    strip.text.x.bottom = element_markdown(
      size = 16,
      face = "bold",
      margin = margin(t = 10)
    )
  )
```

```{r plt_pg_by_payer}
#| column: page
#| out-width: 100%
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 9

payer_df |>
  filter(payer_id %in% top_n_payer_ids) |>
  mutate(
    n_dsn_pg_all_dec = rowSums(
      pick(matches("num_dsn_pg_.*_dec")),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    n_dsn_pg_all_feb = rowSums(
      pick(matches("num_dsn_pg_.*_feb")),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    num_dsn_pg_missing_dec = num_files_expected_dec - n_dsn_pg_all_dec,
    num_dsn_pg_missing_feb = num_files_expected_feb - n_dsn_pg_all_feb,
    across(
      starts_with("num_dsn_pg") & ends_with("dec"),
      \(x) x / num_files_expected_dec
    ),
    across(
      starts_with("num_dsn_pg") & ends_with("feb"),
      \(x) x / num_files_expected_feb
    ),
    ref_int_diff = num_dsn_pg_ref_int_feb - num_dsn_pg_ref_int_dec
  ) |>
  select(
    payer_id,
    payer_name,
    payer_lives,
    starts_with("num_dsn_pg"),
    ref_int_diff
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("num_dsn_pg"),
    names_to = c("ref_type", "month"),
    names_pattern = "num_dsn_pg_(.*)_(dec|feb)",
    values_to = "pct"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    ref_type = factor(
      ref_type,
      levels = c(
        "missing",
        "inline",
        "ref_ext",
        "ref_int"
      )
    ),
    ref_type = fct_relabel(
      ref_type,
      \(x) {
        recode_values(
          x,
          "missing" ~ "Missing or not yet parsed",
          "inline" ~ "Inline references",
          "ref_ext" ~ "External references",
          "ref_int" ~ "Internal references"
        )
      }
    ),
    month = recode_values(
      month,
      "dec" ~ "December 2025",
      "feb" ~ "February 2026"
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    inline_rank = pct[
      ref_type == "Inline references" & month == "December 2025"
    ],
    external_rank = pct[
      ref_type == "External references" & month == "December 2025"
    ],
    .by = "payer_id"
  ) |>
  arrange(inline_rank, desc(external_rank)) |>
  mutate(payer_name = fct_rev(fct_reorder(payer_name, row_number()))) |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_col(
    aes(y = payer_name, x = pct, fill = ref_type),
    width = 0.8
  ) +
  facet_wrap(vars(month)) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Missing or not yet parsed" = "grey80",
      "Inline references" = "#fc8d62",
      "External references" = "#8da0cb",
      "Internal references" = "#66c2a5"
    )
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = label_percent(), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(title = "", reverse = TRUE)) +
  labs(
    title = "Most major payers already use internal provider references",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Between December and February, more ",
      "payers switched to internal references"
    ),
    caption = paste0(
      "Data from Turquoise Health payer database of in-network rate files<br>",
      "* Shows top 50 payers by number of national covered lives, but ",
      "plot order is by percent adoption of internal provider groups"
    ),
    y = "",
    x = "Percent of payer files by type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_markdown(
      size = 19,
      face = "bold",
      margin = margin(b = 8, l = -150)
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_markdown(
      size = 15,
      margin = margin(b = 12, l = -150),
      lineheight = 1.1
    ),
    plot.caption = element_markdown(
      size = 9,
      lineheight = 1.1,
      margin = margin(t = 12, b = 4, r = -15)
    ),
    axis.title.x = element_markdown(
      margin = margin(t = 10),
      size = 16,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.title.y = element_text(
      margin = margin(r = 10),
      size = 16,
      lineheight = 1.1,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.text.x.bottom = element_markdown(
      size = 12,
      lineheight = 1.3
    ),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(1, "cm"),
    axis.ticks.x = element_line(color = "grey40"),
    strip.text.x.top = element_text(
      size = 14,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.box.margin = margin(b = -6, l = -140),
    legend.margin = margin(l = -10, r = 8, t = 6, b = 6),
    legend.text = element_text(
      size = 12
    ),
    legend.title = element_text(
      size = 14,
      face = "bold",
      margin = margin(r = 20)
    ),
    legend.background = element_rect(color = "grey20"),
    plot.margin = margin(l = -20, r = 20, t = 6)
  )
```

```{r plt_nn_by_payer}
#| column: page
```

```{r plt_nn_cnt_per_file_top}
#| column: page

network_names_per_file_feb |>
  unnest(nn_unique_names_lst_feb) |>
  group_by(word = nn_unique_names_lst_feb, payer_id) |>
  summarize(freq = n()) |>
  ungroup() |>
  left_join(payer_names, by = "payer_id") |>
  slice_max(freq, n = 30, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  select(
    `Payer` = payer_name,
    `Network name` = word,
    `Appears in N files` = freq
  ) |>
  gt() |>
  tab_header(
    title = md(
      "The most common network names used by payers are sensible"
    ),
    subtitle = md(
      paste0(
        "Below are the top 30 `network_name` values by number of ",
        "files in February 2026"
      )
    )
  ) |>
  tab_source_note(
    source_note = md(paste0(
      "Names from Turquoise Health payer database of in-network rate files. ",
      "Reflects only posted files. Not all files are posted / parsed for ",
      "February"
    ))
  ) |>
  fmt_number(columns = "Appears in N files", use_seps = TRUE, decimals = 0) |>
  cols_align(align = "left", columns = c("Payer", "Network name")) |>
  cols_align(align = "right", columns = "Appears in N files") |>
  cols_width(
    "Payer" ~ px(250),
    "Network name" ~ px(340),
    "Appears in N files" ~ px(50)
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold", size = px(24)),
    locations = cells_title(groups = "title")
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(size = px(20), color = "grey40"),
    locations = cells_title(groups = "subtitle")
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(
      weight = "bold",
      size = px(15),
      color = "grey30"
    ),
    locations = cells_column_labels()
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(size = px(13)),
    locations = cells_body()
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(size = px(10), color = "grey50"),
    locations = cells_source_notes()
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = list(
      cell_borders(sides = "bottom", color = "#66c2a5", weight = px(3))
    ),
    locations = cells_column_labels()
  ) |>
  tab_options(
    heading.align = "left",
    heading.border.bottom.style = "hidden",
    table.border.top.style = "hidden",
    table.border.bottom.style = "hidden",
    table_body.border.bottom.color = "grey80",
    column_labels.border.top.style = "hidden",
    column_labels.padding = px(4),
    row.striping.include_table_body = TRUE,
    row.striping.background_color = "#f9f9f9",
    data_row.padding = px(6),
    source_notes.padding = px(10)
  )
```

```{r plt_nn_cnt_per_file_bottom}
    table.border.top.style = "hidden",
    table.border.bottom.style = "hidden",
    table_body.border.bottom.color = "grey80",
    column_labels.border.top.style = "hidden",
    column_labels.padding = px(4),
    row.striping.include_table_body = TRUE,
    row.striping.background_color = "#f9f9f9",
    data_row.padding = px(6),
    source_notes.padding = px(10)
  )
```

# File change plots

---

```{r plt_file_size_changes}
#| column: page
#| out-width: 100%
#| fig-width: 10.5
#| fig-height: 9

payer_df |>
  mutate(
    pct_posted = n_dsn_feb / num_files_expected_feb
  ) |>
  mutate(
    pct_diff_bytes = (tot_file_bytes_feb - tot_file_bytes_dec) /
      tot_file_bytes_dec,
    pct_diff_files = (num_files_expected_feb - num_files_expected_dec) /
      num_files_expected_dec,
    pct_diff_avg = (avg_file_bytes_feb - avg_file_bytes_dec) /
      avg_file_bytes_dec,
    nn_added = nn_pct_of_posted >= 0.5,
    pg_int = (num_dsn_pg_ref_int_dec / n_dsn_dec) <
      (num_dsn_pg_ref_int_feb / n_dsn_feb)
  ) |>
  filter(
    payer_id %in% top_n_payer_ids
    # pct_posted >= 0.90,
    # pct_diff_files != 0
  ) |>
  select(
    payer_name,
    pct_diff_bytes,
    diff_bytes_parsed,
    pct_diff_files,
    diff_expected_files,
    pct_diff_avg,
    diff_avg_bytes_parsed,
    nn_added,
    pg_int
  ) |>
  mutate(
    payer_name = str_trunc(payer_name, 40),
    payer_name = paste0(
      payer_name,
      " **<span style='font-family:mono'>(",
      case_when(
        nn_added & pg_int ~ "N,R",
        nn_added ~ "N,<span style='color:white'>□</span>",
        pg_int ~ "<span style='color:white'>□</span>,R",
      ),
      ")</span>**"
    )
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("pct_"),
    names_to = "diff_type",
    values_to = "pct"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    diff = case_when(
    diff_type == "pct_diff_bytes" ~ diff_bytes_parsed,
    diff_type == "pct_diff_avg" ~ diff_avg_bytes_parsed,
    .default =label_comma()(diff_expected_files)
  )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    diff_type = recode_values(
      diff_type,
      "pct_diff_bytes" ~ "Change in total file size",
      "pct_diff_files" ~ "Change in total file count",
      "pct_diff_avg" ~ "Change in avg. file size"
    ),
    diff_type = factor(
      diff_type,
      levels = c(
        "Change in total file size",
        "Change in total file count",
        "Change in avg. file size"
      )
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_col(
    aes(
      x = pct,
      y = payer_name,
      fill = pct > 0
    ),
    width = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      x = pct,
      y = payer_name,
      label = paste0(
        ifelse(pct > 0, "+", ""),
        diff
      ),
      hjust = ifelse(pct < 0, 1.05, -0.05)
    ),
    size = 3,
    check_overlap = TRUE,
    color = "grey30"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(vars(diff_type), ncol = 3, strip.position = "bottom") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    name = NULL,
    labels = label_percent(),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.35, 0.3)),
    breaks = c(-1, -0.5, 0, 0.5, 1)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = NULL,
    values = c(
      "FALSE" = "#66c2a5",
      "TRUE" = "#fc8d62"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste0(
      "File sizes and counts are decreasing following TiC 2.0 schema changes"
    ),
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Payers that add <span style='font-family:mono'>network_name</span> ",
      "(**N**), inline provider groups (**R**), or do both (**N,R**) see ",
      "reduced file sizes"
    ),
    caption = paste0(
      "**N** means >= 50% of posted Feb. files have a network name. ",
      "**R** means the percentage files using inline references increased ",
      "from Dec. 2025 to Feb. 2026<br>",
      "Data from Turquoise Health database of in-network rate files. ",
      "Only payers with >= 90% of their Feb. files posted / ",
      "processed are included. Numbers may change as more files are added"
    ),
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_markdown(
      size = 20,
      face = "bold",
      margin = margin(b = 8, l = -190)
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_markdown(
      size = 16,
      margin = margin(b = 12, l = -190),
      lineheight = 1.1
    ),
    plot.caption = element_markdown(
      size = 9,
      lineheight = 1.1,
      margin = margin(t = 12)
    ),
    axis.title.x = element_markdown(
      margin = margin(t = 10),
      size = 14,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.title.y = element_markdown(
      margin = margin(r = 2),
      size = 14,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.text.x = element_markdown(
      size = 11,
      hjust = c(0.75, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.3)
    ),
    axis.text.y.left = element_markdown(
      size = 11
    ),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(-0.4, "cm"),
    strip.text.x.bottom = element_text(
      size = 14,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    strip.placement = "outside"
  )
```
